items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Barron Wilkins had the big nightclub where Ethel Waters and them went, on 135th Street.

ctx.x: Who was who. He was working in Barron Wilkins' joint as a waiter when Charleston killed Barron Wilkins. Barron Wilkins had the big nightclub where Ethel Waters and them went, on 135th Street. And his brother had Wilkins' on the other side of the street, that was one of the greatest nightclubs in New York -- but he didn't allow no White folks in this club. The White folks would go up to Barron Wilkins' club and say, "Let's go... Why can't we go to the other place where they're swingin' over there?" He'd say, "No,…
